newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Citicorp 1998 EPS view lowered.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Citicorp 1998 EPS view lowered.

text.p: Gerard Klauer Mattison & Co Inc analyst George Salem said Wednesday he trimmed the 1998 earnings estimate for Citicorp, reiterated a hold rating, and believes the stock may lage its peers.
Salem cut the 1998 earnings estimate to $9.30 per share from $$9.40 but kept the 1997 estimate unchanged at $8.40.

"This is a classic case of quality of earnings deterioriaton," he said. He said the stock has been regarded by many investors as a major growth stock and has had outstanding performance. But he said in the future the stock may lag its banking peers.

Salem said during the second quarter "one major cylinder of their engine almost conked out." He said he was referring to the U.S. credit card business. He said the problem was not just credit losses in U.S. cards but operating expenses were also hurting the unit.

The analyst said gains from securities sales and venture capital profits were at record levels in the second quarter and helped bolster the overall result which had net income up eight percent from a year ago. But he said the core business lines, the global consumer business and the corporate bank, together gained only one percent.
